description:
Find orthologues or paralogues of a gene across species (Ensembl Compara) — the cross-species gene mapping source in biomcp.

Returns target stable IDs, gene symbols (when the assembly provides them, e.g. ARAF/RAF1 for BRAF paralogs), species, taxonomy level, and percent identity, sorted by identity. Accepts an HGNC symbol or Ensembl gene ID; scope to one species with target_species ('mouse') or target_taxon (10090).
Use it for conservation questions ('is this gene conserved?', 'what is the mouse orthologue of BRAF?').

gene.description: Gene symbol (BRAF) or Ensembl gene ID (ENSG00000157764)

limit.description: Maximum homologies to return (sorted by percent identity)

target_species.description: Restrict results to one species, e.g. 'mouse'

target_taxon.description: Restrict results to a taxon ID, e.g. 10090 (Mus musculus)

name: ensembl_homology
